Method of Attack: Moves victim's files into password protected RAR archives using a bundled WinRar.exe executable
Demands a $50 Amazon gift card code for archive password
Extracts and executes WinRar.exe from %Temp% folder to archive files in Documents, Pictures, and Desktop folders
Distributed via email campaign pretending to be Adobe Flash Player update
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Documents, Pictures, and Desktop folders
Attack Vector: Email phishing campaign with fake Adobe Flash Player update link
Indicators of Compromise: Discord contact named Unname3d for ransom payment
Spam email pretending to be from Adobe Flash Player
